axis: The long local axis runs north–south. The large gold inscription faces local -X toward the north end of Tiananmen Square. The multi-column dedication faces south.
visualScope: Tiananmen Square memorial with two terraced platforms, eight stair runs, carved white railings, ten relief compositions, the tapered granite shaft, north and south inscriptions and wreath cornices.
limitations: Stair, deck, plinth and shaft dimensions follow PMTiles. The small stone apron reconciles standard Terrarium samples with the level plaza seen in photographs. The rest of the square retains native terrain and map features.
Individual carved figures, clouds, wreaths and historic calligraphy are represented by modeled approximations. The inscription text follows the map record.
